verifications.claim: Landman has been officially renewed for a third season by Paramount+
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Landman was officially renewed for a third season on Dec. 5, 2025 (R3); Paramount announced on Dec. 5, 2025, that it had renewed Landman for a third season (R6); Paramount+ gave Landman its order for a third season in Dec. 2025 (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm official renewal by Paramount+.

verifications.claim: Landman season two had record viewership
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: season 2, which delivered the biggest season or series premiere in Paramount+ history, pulling in 9.2 million views (R3); delivered record numbers on its Season 2 premiere... most-watched premiere for any original series on Paramount+ (R6); Season 2 broke just about every streaming record Paramount+ had (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe season 2 viewership as record-breaking.

verifications.claim: Production for Landman season 3 is set to begin in May 2026
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: ‘Landman’ Season 3 Filming Starts May 2026 (R1 title); you go back into production in May (R5)
verifications.reasoning: R5 directly states production in May; R1 title supports, though body lacks content.

verifications.claim: Filming for Landman season 3 begins May 2026 in Texas
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: Filming Starts May 2026 (R1 title); heat in Texas... back into production this year, it’s going to be pretty full on (R5)
verifications.reasoning: May 2026 supported; Texas implied via heat reference in production context, but not explicit for filming location.

verifications.claim: Landman season 3 filming in May 2026 is later than previous seasons
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: We are a little bit later than we were the last two seasons
verifications.reasoning: Direct statement that season 3 production is later than previous seasons.

verifications.claim: Woman's World described Landman season 3 production as "full on" production during hot weather
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1 contains no such description (only ads); it’s going to be pretty full on, and just getting hotter (R5, Hollywood Reporter)
verifications.reasoning: Phrase appears in R5 (Hollywood Reporter), not Woman's World (R1); wrong source attribution.
